why: The tooltip stops saying that the palette reaches the NEXT match (issue #1058). A session reads it once, when it is built, so a player who switches from Pause sees no change in the match they are playing and has no way to tell that from a control that does nothing. Modelled on quality-toggle-hides-when-the-choice-applies.
killedBy: hud: the owner-palette toggle (issue #1058) says WHEN the choice takes effect, which the label cannot show
